notes: Sourced directly from Ferrofish's official A32pro/A32pro Dante user manual (v3.1, PDF) and product page (ferrofish.com), which document both the A32pro and A32pro Dante variants side by side. The Dante variant adds the 64x64 Audinate Brooklyn board with 2x RJ45 (Pri/Sec redundant) network ports versus the standard A32pro. Analog I/O uses 4x D-Sub25 (female, Tascam pinout) for the 32 inputs and 4x D-Sub25 (female, Tascam pinout) for the 32 outputs -- 8 D-Sub25 connectors total. ADAT is 4 optical TOSLINK inputs + 4 optical TOSLINK outputs (manual states "4+4 optical interfaces"; ports are color-coded by flap color rather than individually labeled). MADI uses dual hot-swappable SFP cages (unit ships with one Multi-Mode optical SFP module installed; coax/singlemode SFPs are compatible options) -- graded sdi-12g is not applicable since MADI is not an SDI/BNC signal, so no bandwidth grade tag applies to the SFP slots per the taxonomy (SFP connector has no defined grade scale in the provided list). Wordclock uses two separate BNC jacks (IN and OUT), both with 75-ohm switchable termination. MIDI I/O is 2x 1/8" (3.5mm) TRS jacks (IN/OUT) following MIDI 2.0 Type A pinout, not the classic 5-pin DIN, so connector was set to trs-3.5. GPIO is a female D-Sub15 connector for general-purpose trigger I/O (4 in / 4 out) -- mapped to the closest available connector id (euroblock-dc omitted; no D-Sub id exists in the taxonomy, so it is noted here rather than force-fit; omitted from the ports list as it is a control/logic connector rather than AV signal or power, but flagged in case it should be included as "other"). Power: dual redundant 12V/3A DC inputs via 2.5mm center-pin-positive barrel jacks with a screw-lock retaining nut (only 1 external PSU ships standard); mapped to dc-barrel. USB is a USB-B port (USB2, class-compliant MIDI-over-USB, no audio transport). No wattage/version info was found suggesting HDMI/SDI/DisplayPort presence -- this device has none. Rack unit: 1U (19" x 1U, 4.4cm height). No public region variants beyond A32pro (non-Dante) vs A32pro Dante were noted.
